What patients look for on a clinic website

If any of this is missing, they go to the clinic next door. That's why it's all built into the structure from the start.

  • Doctors

    Photos, specialisation and experience. Patients choose a doctor, not a building.

  • Prices

    At least starting prices for the main services. That means fewer calls just to ask what it costs.

  • Address and directions

    Map, landmark, parking and opening hours on every page.

  • Licence

    Licence and documents on a separate page. It's a matter of trust.

  • Booking

    A Telegram booking button and phone number in the header and on every screen.

  • Several branches or online booking?

    We'll build a site in Russian and Uzbek with a separate page for each branch.
